text: it started OK but then it becomes impossible to complete days without spending money. Dishes get increasingly harder to complete, the energy given for free is nowhere close to enough...I was almost in a trance...spent so much money then they started to decrease the rewards and the things you get when buying bundles... the first time I kept going but the second increase actually woke me up! thankfully, I stopped paying for stuff altogether 🤣🤣 and will uninstall the game as it got boring

Enjoyed the first few hours of play but without paying - which I refuse to do - it is hard to complete levels and so I am at a point now where I will delete it as it is literally taking days to complete just half of one order. Was fun whilst it lasted and understand the creators are there to make a profit but no longer interested in playing.

Good game, bad monetisation. when I first started playing I liked how there were cheap options in the pay to win shop. I didn't mind the odd £1-2 here and there and I'd even stretch to £5ish for some extra gems now and then. Now those options have vanished and the only things with cheaper options are gems. Fishing for whales in this economy is bananas, stop leaving your average customers in the dust :(

it started off ok, but I've spent 4 days trying to complete a single order without spending actual money. I reckon it'll take another 2 days to complete the order. "energy" costs more the more you buy it... 10, 20, 80 then 160 gems to refill. If youre doing "pay to win" you'll need deep pockets

10 stars.... Love this game. Been playing it for 6 months if not longer. Puzzle Merge Logic all in one!!! Update: Level 403 and still loving the gameplay.. My main issue is that the further you get, the fewer/smaller rewards you get, meaning you have to make purchases more often or gameplay takes forever...

it starts fun, then becomes impossible to complete without purchasing a bundle. THIS IS WHERE IT IS A SCAM! I purchased a £1.89 gem bundle, they are opposite sides of the screen, but it decided to do an £89 bundle, I immediately tried to stop the purchase and cancel, I couldn't. I contacted customer service, to tell them I hadn't selected this, and it happened in error, to be told too late its done, we have a no refund policy. regardless of anything I said, I was basically told its tough. avoid!

it's fun, it doesnt really stand out that much from other merging games but that's ok. a few downsides compared to other merging games: - the generators go on cooldown way too quick for way too long. sometimes you need 1 more item and even if you have full energy, the cooldown on the generators are 1+ hour after like 20 uses - barely any ways to get gems besides spending money - barely any way to get energy besides spending money

As others have said, it's pay to play. I was flooded with ads for this game so I decided to give it a chance - I was pleasantly surprised that there really are no ads but I very quickly found out you won't progress unless you pay. Generators only give you 10 items before they need to recharge for 2 hours, and I'm still on the low levels. Just don't bother, unless you want to spend your hard earned cash.

I love playing this game, mainly when I'm on flambe mode and have loads of energy. it's so frustrating waiting for the cool downs! I'm currently stuck on day 57 because everything I need to complete the day is from the fruit basket. After tapping 10-15 times it's recharging for an hour! So annoying, if the recharge times weren't as long or you got more rewards out of them, it would be a brilliant game.

So much more fun than other games of this type. You do start running out of energy pretty quickly after the first few hours of play, but there are lots of ways to earn a bit back here and there, if you dont want to spend. The animations & graphics look nicer than a lot of these too. No ads. I do wish the cheaper buy energy options were always available & not just at random.

Started off great fun but got boring very quickly! the wait times are far too long for generators and the generators dont give equal items, loads of energy used for certain easy dishes. the mini games dont last long enough and again with those you dont generate enough of the items needed. unless you're willing to spend real money id avoid this game.

I love this game. It really checks all the boxes. Unfortunately, I have to take a star away for in-game notifications. What a pain. Don't play on the bus, by the time you x out of all offers, events, reminders, super offers, more events, extra offers, and reminders of super offers... your bus just arrived at its destination.

Game is fun for about two days and spending a lot of money to keep it going. When you don't spend money the game is impossible to play. It is so slow that it becomes boring. Be careful that you don't fall for the initial fun because you will end up spending alot of money with very little reward. The creators do not provide enough boosters too keep you playing and then potentially spend more money. Initial fun is not worth the slow, boring, drag as you go up in levels.

When I first downloaded this I really liked it although I have spent a stupid amount of money on it which I've never done ever. But they just rolled out an update that's brought it down a ⭐️ daily goals are now even harder meaning you don't get the rewards easily and gold cards have been introduced which makes the card collection completely unattainable. I've come close on all of them but can't see how I'm ever going to complete a set now the gold packs are a thing. Orders need to give more back

The game started off great. I love that it isn't just a merging game you can put things on chopping board, blender to make new recipes etc. But as you progress further in the game you use up literally all your energy (I had 200) just to complete one order on the board because one order requires too many items to make and then generator item runs out and I have to wait about 2 hrs. This is too long. Could have made it so that each item doesn't require that many merges to make.

The game looks nice, and I generally like the cooking aspects, however it is very slow to progress, and there a nothing to help sort the items in the grid yet it gets messy super often. Sorting by source from one button click would be really nice. Also getting an empty chest with a fishing rod is a kick in the teeth when it can take ages to get a fishing rod in the first place. I will try and play a bit more, but I'm not ready to put money into it yet like I do other games.

I absolutely love this game BUT you do have to spend a little money.. eventually. The beginning is super fun and lots of rewards are given, but when you advance in levels, recipes and goals get harder. It can take days to fulfill just one order so you miss out on events and rewards because you aren't able to fill orders as quickly. It is possible to play without spending, but it is not fun because you will have to spend a while waiting for energy to refill and generators to charge.

Pay to play. The wall comes fast and hard. 50+hrs to complete a single set of orders if you don't sleep/set an alarm every 200 minutes is ridiculous. And that's without including secret recharge times for generators that always mostly spit out basic items anyway. All during an event that lasts 48hrs and needs multiple sets of orders to get through the easier early half!! No point downloading it unless you're prepared to drop $300+ a month for a playable version.

Interesting game. However I tried to do it with minimum purchase (without purchase it'll take eternity to finish a game order) and it took me 3 days to finish one order!! Logged in every 4 hours (when "energy" renews). So my conclusion - a game made only for money grabs. Prices are very high, considering it's a simple game without even energy rewards after finishing level. It's really sad, because I somehow enjoyed it. Uninstalling.

Disappointing . I have been playing this for a few months now. The levels now are impossible. It takes days now rather than hours to complete a task/dish. Constantly running out of energy. When you have the energy and it's not recharging,it gives you what you don't want , ie you want cans and it gives you pints. Would have been a five when I first installed it. Would have recommended it too,not now. It's frustrating and annoying. Don't bother find another game.

Love the style and graphics of the game! however, I get about 2, maybe 3 orders a day completed. This is because the orders are getting bigger and takes too much energy to get half way to an ingredient I need. the free daily box gives me 4 very basic ingredients that aren't helpful at all and would be better if they got better as the days go on. I can handle 4 ingredients if they were useful. I'm not deleting the app yet, will give it another month but if nothing improves then I'm going to

The game used to be fun but eventually it gets very repetitive. the mini games just rotate every few days. The rewards for building the restaurant don't increase as the levels get harder. I'm on day 385 now and I noticed a drastic increase in needing multiple level 5+ rare items from the same generator to complete a dish. It takes hundreds of energy units just to get the one dish, often taking 2-3 days. The game is getting boring.

Great game. This is the best merge game I've played so far. It's very fun and engaging. The graphics are gorgeous and food pieces look so real. There are no adds either. You can play it without having to buy extra energy. However, you will get through orders and days quicker, if you do. The customer service is quick and helpful too. Overall, great entertainment. :)

Good game that I've not grown tired of like others. Does have its limits, like the recharge mechanic on certain generators, even if you spend gems to refresh them and they will only give you 5 or 6 items before running out and youre unable to see the amount of time it takes before they refresh. very heavy on guiding users to pay for perks, seems the longer you have the game the less time you can play it as the orders are harder and without spending money it can take a long time to even finish 1

Started playing this game because at first it was fun, but the pace slows down to an unreasonable wait time when the orders get harder, it just becomes boring real fast and it's a pressure for you to spend more and more money on it. I see people writing the same reviews and they just get answers from AI and not real people. This is just a game to get you hooked and then spend a ridiculous amount of money to keep going. I've hit that wall I think, will be uninstalling it.

This is truly terrible game! Takes up far too much energy to make the dishes as you progress through the game. On Day 76 now and it's taken almost 2 days, playing multiple times a day to get the ingredients for one dish and honestly, that was boring gameplay. Also, the rewards for exchanging duplicate cards are an absolute joke - just exchanged 500 duplicate cards and got 4 more duplicates and 1 unique card, 1! No energy, no items, nothing!

Was fine for so long but now when I leave the game to go do something else, it deletes the progress I already got to. It gets rid of food pieces I ALREADY MADE and I already had a dish cooking, then I left, I come back a few hrs later and it's no longer cooking it, the pieces gone too. I updated. Why does it keep loosing progress?! Also when you pay to recharge generator, it gives less than half the amount of pieces. Just another scammy game unfortunately, they just want you to spend money.

it's a good game, I do play daily. but it is extremely slow paced the icons you tap to get objects take a long time to regenerate and don't always regenerate fully. they seem to want you to spend money and alot of it but I refuse to. the game for me isn't good enough to put money into it. gossip harbor is a much better merge game.

I haven't even been playing this for 24 hours and the amount of "help" I'm receiving makes me want to uninstall it. Where I appreciate a little bit of help in explaining how the game works, most of us aren't quite stupid enough to need the amount of "help" this game seems to think we need. The constant interruptions when I am merging and forcing me to go build when I don't want to are BS. I can decide when I want to get my free gifts, merge my items, or build.

There isn't much to separate this from any other merge-cooking game, but if you like them, you'll like this. Like other games like this you eventually get to a place where you can't possibly fulfill a single order in a day without paying for more energy, but one you get to that point just delete it and download another game from this genre. They're all identical.

fun game but tries to force micro transactions with a bad energy system. almost impossible to play for more than a few minutes. EDIT: To generate an ingredient costs an energy unit. Energy has a refresh rate of 1 unit per 2 minutes, capping at 100. You are not guaranteed to get the item you need for a merge every click. In early levels, this is fine, but as the game progresses it becomes unsustainable without micro transactions.

I wish I would have read the reviews before playing. The gameplay is great but you cant really play it because everything has a cool down period of minimally an hour? And the purchasing options dont really make sense. I've been struggling with playing for a while and I'm only on day 75. The tasks are taking longer and longer to complete. I wish I would have known before I played bc I like it so much but cant play it 🤦🏾‍♀️

it's nice there are a big variety of dishes that you can make in the game but, dang, how it's tiring to try to farm for ingredients for them! I'm really this 🤏🏻 close to uninstalling the game and I refuse to spend even a penny of real money on this game. I always thought that the main goal of such games is to keep the player in the game but this one does the opposite: I log in, spend 10 minutes until I run out of energy or the cool down effect kicks it, and leave the game.

2nd Update: I'm taking away another star as it is almost impossible to play without spending real money. It takes a day, maybe more, to complete the last order of the day as you progress. Too little energy to play even if you try to get the daily bits and bobs. I really liked this game until a few months ago, when the mindset started getting really commercial. Now I'm this close 🤏🏻 to uninstalling.

fun and super addictive, only thing is the energy doesn't last very long so in order to complete any orders you'll have to buy more energy. that's where they get ya. Absolutely no adds which is great, but this game wouldn't be fun at all without energy, so like I said you dump money into the game for energy so you can progress, before you know it you've paid $20 into a game. love this game, but honestly wish I would've never downloaded it. so if you don't want to spend money, don't download

I LOVE this game, but...most of the generators only give a few items, then you have to wait anywhere from 5 minutes to over an hour and a half for more. Takes me a couple of days just to finish some orders. If they regenerated in half an hour and/or gave more items each time, it would be a solid 5 star from a lot of us.

Completely Unplayable. Even if you spent money, and they want you to, there's no possibility of playing this game. The game resources are so tightly limited that to play the game at all would cost about $100 per hour, but even then, you wouldn't be able to play for a full hour. This must be a drug and see trafficking money laundering cover story. It isn't a playable game at any amount of money you could spend.

Thee game has no constant play where there's no sort of mini games to help you progress and stay in the game, the gems and energy winnings in the events cycle also doesn't allow you to export them to the main board like other merge and cook games it's ridiculous. Otherwise I do enjoy it just badly designed and to keep playing consistently costs a hell of a lot. So entertainment and engagement isn't great at all.

No ads, which is nice. However, like with most merge games, they catch you on how fast you run out of energy, a limit on ingredient generation, and times to "cook" an item especially when dealing with a higher tier item you have to merge. Repetitive after a while, so uninstalling.

it sucks you In by being easy and fun in the beginning levels but as you advance the energy you need to continue to play never improves so you can only get so far without playing. you have to serve 8 or 9 customers to make one "day" and the last 3 are so hard to get because the groceries/nets/baskets you need to give you the ingredients are constantly recharging for 30minutes to an hour at a time. super frustrating. it makes you lose out on all of the contests if you arent willing to pay!

The game's nice and all. Nice interface, good engagement but massive downside to it. There's no way to renew energy. let alone gems, without paying. You guys should at least add an option where one can watch ads and be rewarded with gems and energy rather than only through payment, when no be CODM or Bloodstrike. E joor.... Do something and also increase energy limits as one's level increases. 100 energy limit is too small to complete orders from level 50 and above, even 150 sef still too small

Good game at first! It's a lot of fun but there are many issues with it. First, I've spent probably $10 in the past week or so & I quickly realized even when you purchase packs that have energy & diamonds you can only play this game for 20 to 30 minutes max! This is because they don't give enough energy & it costs way too much energy to make a lot of the items that are required to fulfill the orders to advance in the game. So I have to exit & wait for energy constantly! Super disappointing!

Overall the game is quite engaging..but it gets frustrating when some tasks take 2-3 days to complete due to lack of Energy . and it gets annoying when the merging of items takes 3-4 days to get a product given in the task. Initially I used to play with excitement but now due to this I am losing interest in this game . Please provide some rewards or increase energy so that it could be easy to complete the task.

Every update makes it harder and harder to complete quests. Now, even if i save up energy (I had 700 saved up a few days ago), it's impossible to complete them. It went from 7 orders in a day to 9 or 10. To complete cards, you get the ones you need a lot less frequently. I thought it might just be because I was progressing in the game, but my phone broke and I had to get a new one. Had to start the game over and its like that from the beginning now. It's just not fun anymore.

Lots of fun, and you can play fully for free with no external ads, but it's slow going making progress without spending money. This game is less generous with giving free gems and energy than I've seen in some other games (like Royal Kingdom), but with enough patience, you do get those bonuses eventually. Overall, I really enjoy this game, though I go into it knowing my progress will be slow.

Fun game but can't play more than 5 mins max a time after passing the first 2 environments. It gets harder as you level up so there's no satisfaction of leveling and things getting easier. To continue playing you'd have to be spending upwards of 10$ per day, which is insane. I don't need all the extra side games this developer keeps producing. Would rather they simplify it, less flashy, and make it more affordable and longer play time. Ad in optional ads to get energy or something.

This is the only merge game I've played where the generators run out of charge so quickly and take way too long to recharge, like over an hour. Even after they recharge, you have to wait a while or you get barely any items out of it. Same with if you use/buy gems to recharge them, you get barely any items. I don't buy gems/energy because it's pointless. This game could be good if it wasn't unplayable, maybe two minutes max in a day

I like this game a lot. I want to say I love it but the wait times once the generators "cool" are just too long. I understand the bigger the item, the longer it will take but when you get a little further along, the wait time gets longer and more frustrating because you can't really take part in the events they have. Also, once you make a purchase, the options only increase in cost. It doesn't make sense to punish someone for spending money on the game. Keep the lower cost items available.

fun game till level 75, then it becomes a pay to play game. it took me 5 days of logging in multiple times per day for full recharges to cook 2 dishes consisting of rank 10 products. there is no other way to get higher ingredients than paying for them. ofc you can continue to play but its a huge grind. so either merge items, with limits to charges or reach level 75, uninstall to play another game :) i assume max 2 more days and i have to uninstall the game

I enjoy this game but it would be rather better if the event criteria for higher levels were different. May be you could just reduce the amount of levels required to complete a task in event and extend the amount of energy available from 100 to 150 or above as the level advances. similarly some recipes requires days to get completed which makes the whole experience frustrating and boring so make sure to fix this problem. otherwise the playing experience is really good...

3 stars for the cute aesthetics and I do like how this game keep me engaged and immersed if I get to move from one goal to another. I appreciate how there's a slight increase in energy that's given on Facebook's links too. However, the extreme usage of energy to achieve just one single item on the menu is incredulous. Would suggest that more is done to cater to those who plays for free.

I reached Level 125, so this review comes from an active player. The game starts fun but becomes increasingly pay-to-win. The energy cap stays at only 100 even at high levels, and building rewards never scale. The card collection system feels impossible to complete without spending money, as I repeatedly end each season around 90/108 cards despite playing daily. Events have the same issue. Eventually, progress depends more on paying than playing, which made me uninstall the game.

Fun game! My only setback is you have to wait so long for the generators to recharge and they take hours. Its one thing I have to wait for more energy but also I have to wait on the generators too. Annoying. It doesn't really entice me to buy any packages but causes me to lose interest.

good game until you get to higher level orders which if you don't spend money takes days or week to fill. higher level generators, like level 8 still give mostly level one stuff while you need level 7 or 8 items for completion of meals and the generators time out way before you get your items. multiple generators are needed yet low space fills fast when trying to get high level items for orders. I wouldn't recommend it for people that are completionists. Still the same uninstalled again 6/2026.

At first I was loving the game.. but now it seems since more people are playing u have become greedy. this game is like others to me. a money pit. the more u want to play the more u have to pay. then the fact that the game throws out the opposite of what u need more so u use up the amount of times u have to merge is disappointing. it's all to use up the moves faster and then they want u to pay 7.99 to refill. im not paying any more.

The ONLY feature in Flambe that makes it more interesting than others is how you use appliances to '"cook" the generated items so you can fill orders. Out of the three merge games I've kept, Flambe has the best ratio of easy/hard levels (some "days" require thousands of 'energy', while others you can finish with the allotted 100), yet it has the most costly packs, as well as the least opportunities to win diamonds or more energy.

After the initial introduction, it doesn't offer very many free energy points. If you want a free game, DONT bother with this. Otherwise, it's not too bad. Typical merge game, doesn't excel beyond others. They don't offer anything special that the other merge games don't all have as well. If you don't mind spending $5/session on extra energy, then get this. If you want something free, this isn't for you. It's nearly impossible to make progress if you don't spend a few bucks every time you play.

Why is there energy!? Love this game, probably would play it for hours. But every time I get on a roll, I run out of energy! And you have to pay for more! (I'd rather watch ads to get extra energy. But I can't complain cause this game has NO ads, which I appreciate a lot). Great game, super addictive, fun, and stimulating. I had to say something about this stupid energy. JUST GIVE US MORE WAYS TO GET ENERGY, THAT'S HOW YOU PLAY! If I can't play, then I leave...simple.

I genuinely LOVE this game ALOT, but... Cons that matter: 1.) When the merge station "runs out" you have to wait an hour plus, & it is not only expensive to re-open but it only last for like 8 or so presses! What a waste of gems and money! 2.) It NEVER offers to watch an AD for more energy or to produce the product in the bubbles. 3.) Merging hardly EVER will get you perks. It's all about the "sells".. WHICH SUCKS when you need more energy & want to play the other side games. Good game tho.😭

the game is fun, however; I'd rather watch advertisements in order to generate more energy. I don't appreciate the "no ad" option. I'd rather watch ads than spend another dollar in this game. we have no options to gain more energy, as soon as my 2 days are up due to the very expensive "VIP" perk I purchased that isn't doing a thing for me if I can't complete an order. I really wish you developers would allow us the players some grace, and not only think of filling your own pockets. 😢

This game is fun and I really like the cooking concept and cute graphics. Its enjoyable and merging ingredients is satisfying. However, one thing that makes the experience frustrating is the generators. They run out very quickly and take too long to reload before they can be used again. Even when my energy is full, I still cant continue playing because Im stuck waiting for the generators to recharge. I hope the developers can improve the cooldown time so the gameplay feels smother&more enjoyable

The game itself is awesome. But generators such as veggies one, starts recharging too fast. I need cabbage. I was waiting 3 hours to be able to produce more, but it's recharging again. So I should wait 59 min. more. Is it not ridiculous? I have 2 last orders, both need this generator. Other similar games don't ask to wait for so long. I can watch ad to recharge it faster. Why you don't do the same? About energy. I've no gems, I can't produce at all. Give us to watch ads for more energy.

Lame - no storyline at all (I'm a week and an entire chapter in game and the only thing any character has said is some variation of 'hi I'm Lauren let's get to work' when you first open the game. The mechanics are kinda neat, but not enough to carry an entire game on their own Game isn't even as fun as the ads. In short: don't bother.

been playing a longtime. the further you get the more energy the items take. love it, but really pissing me off that I do spend money to merge items, wake up next day to finish and multiple items show incomplete after already completed previously. this is a known issue they choose not to fix. if you spend money it's a slap in the face. very disappointing they do nothing to compensate you when they know this happens more often than not. I shouldn't have to screen record when developers know.

what the heck are you supposed to do with the green items? the little hand appears indicating to click it, but there's nowhere to put them item. it doesn't interact with the order ticket or anything. So unintuitive. Turns out you have to double click stupidly fast. I guess this is something poorly imported from a desktop version. It's super annoying on mobile with a touch screen.

I enjoy the mundane-ness of this game. At times though it takes a WEEK or more to get through one day of cooking. I spend money on a game that I feel would help me along but with this one the purchase options wouldn't help reduce cook time so they're pointless to buy. you get little energy for your money. There are no ads but I'd watch an ad for energy ATP.

I fairly enjoy the game, love how it's add free and the way we are unlocking so many recipes and renovating different restaurants. However, what I don't understand is when I'm redeeming the duplicate star cards, i still get duplicates - whats the purpose of having them, this is so unfair and waste collecting them on the first place. Also I guess we need to have the energy limit increased beyond 100 as the orders are extremely time taking. Please consider these for better experience.

Lovely game but it's a game meant to scam money out of users and benefit the developers. You can't enjoy participating in events as it takes 3 days to complete some orders because item generators are forever on long hours breaks and even when they are back to generating they generate 5 items and go back on a break. Games are meant to be fun, not frustrating and bleed money out of people. Let people spend by choice not because they are forced to.

Hi my dear Flame game developers, I really love this game and play it every day. However, I would like to suggest an improvement. Please consider increasing the energy and diamonds with each level. Currently, they do not increase at all, and the amount remains the same for the next levels. This makes it very difficult to progress because too much energy is required. Please update the game to provide more energy and diamonds as players level up.

as the levels up, the recipes are getting harder. but the generators still give only the basic ingredients. while the recipes getting harder generators also should give little higher ingredients rather than basic ones. also generator cool down period is too long. Finally I will be uninstalling due to the long resume time. loosing the interest to play.

I noticed the prices of items to purchase keeps going higher by 3 times everytime you buy it.. not a good thing honestly.. You want engagement/revenue not happening with unnecessary hikes for people willing to spend.. Rather have the prices lowered and more genuine players rather than high pricing and very few players to spend..

Hello, so you guys have become so lazy that all you can do is just respond with a consolation and then leave it at that. you have no intention to look into the issues the players are sharing with you over here and on the mail too. and still you don't wanna resolve the issue. since 1 entire day I've been trying to finish one order that's of the wine generator. right after 10 clicks the generators go into recharging and I can't play anymore. we pay, spend, mail, msg, but you don't wanna resolve

I am playing for the last 3 months and I love this game. I just wish you guys would give out free energy to the players who are following your page on Facebook. It's frustrating when you so close to completing an order but run out of energy and you got to wait so long for energy to fill up 😞 then you gotta restart the pot 😞

okay, what are we doing right now? there is an overabundance of bots, and they win almost instantly (in the cake match thing)to make you pay. I mean this game is fun for about a few days, but yep, you know it. also, I'm not surprised. every merge game is the same and yeah, I know what you will say. and you still cant fix this problem. as a f2p user, I am SUFFERING from these hard days. pitiful game. I'd rather get burnt. you are NOT slick with the money required to purchase.

I love the concept of the game however, there is no way to obtain any free energy. The further you progress the more complicated the dishes become which is great but you are unable to complete even one dish with the energy given. I do not recommend getting invested in this game unless you plan to spend alot of money.

Love it but I'm at day 65 and patience is waning. I've completed all the orders except one. From about midday I've been working on the one order and the generators only give 12 produce and takes 1hr to recharge. I've never had so much unused lightening in a long time, here waiting to use them on the fruit basket

too expensive! this game made to force you to make in-app purchases so you can stay in the game more than 10 to 15 minutes. you also won't be able to finish any of the events in the game without purchasing extra energy and diamonds for currency to get through the game. I figured out you have to purchase at least $40 a month in order to win an event. that is absolutely ridiculous

Im absolutely obsessed with this game but im also extremely disappointed. I spend a lot of money on this game, but today 7/1/26, I noticed they are stealing from me!!! I was playing earlier and I had 173 blue icons to use (the blue bolts-energy), but when I woke up from a nap, they were gone! I only had 56. What happened to the bolts I had??!! So not fair. Wow. 😔

This game punishes you for playing it. If you play longer than 15 minutes, all the resource items need to "recharge" most of which last 2+ hours. Not only that, there's a pointer finger that directs you for THE WHOLE GAME. Not the tutorial or your first time playing, the entire thing.

boy those hints are annoying. stop telling me where to tap, I'm not an imbecile! and yes, I've turned off hints. I still have that annoying pointing finger popping up everywhere. yes, thank you, I understand how the app works, it's not rocket science. honestly, WHY would you ruin a perfectly nice game with THAT? at least I think it's supposed to be a nice game, I haven't got to enjoy it seeing THAT DAMN FINGER won't let me tap in peace. will it ever go away? pls tell me it will

I really enjoyed this game, until I got to the point where orders take hundreds of energy to fill- like, come on- 300 energy for one vegetable, and then you need a fish that takes 600 energy to get to?
